waypoints.name: Alpental / Snow Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: North end of the main Alpental Ski Area parking lot, off Alpental Rd near Snoqualmie Pass (I-90 exit 52); standard approach for New York Gully via Snow Lake trail then Phantom Slide/Source Lake basin.
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 52 at Snoqualmie Pass, go north under the freeway and take the second right onto Alpental Road, then drive about 1.3 miles to the Alpental Ski Area lots at the road's end. Winter climbers commonly park in the groomer lot about 200 ft past the main day lot.

waypoints.name: Snoqualmie Mountain summit
waypoints.note: This route is on Snoqualmie Mountain's NW face, not Chair Peak, reached from the Alpental/Snow Lake trailhead.
waypoints.directions: Walk up the open hillside toward the Alpental waterfalls, cut left into the trees at their base through two steep cliff bands, then move right onto the Phantom Slide and climb it to about 4,900 ft before trending left to the northwest-shoulder notch near 5,200 ft. Downclimb about 200 ft, traverse to the first obvious gully and climb it to a col between gendarmes, rappel into Enigma Gully and climb its snow to the summit.
